# Let's Talk Trail

> > A slow travel and outdoor adventure blog focusing on hiking trails, vegan dining, and sustainable travel across Japan and beyond.

Let's Talk Trail is written by Hannah Löwenhardt and features detailed hiking guides (especially in Japan's Hokkaido and Kyoto regions), vegan restaurant recommendations in Japanese cities, and practical tips for sustainable and mindful travel. The site emphasizes Leave No Trace principles and plant-based travel experiences.

## Key Topics

- Japan travel and hiking
- Vegan dining in Japan
- Hokkaido trails (Asahidake to Kurodake)
- Kyoto hiking (Fushimi Inari, Mount Inari)
- Tokyo vegan restaurants
- Sustainable travel practices
- Hut-to-hut hiking
- Leave No Trace principles
- Japanese cuisine (natto, okonomiyaki, shojin ryori)
- Japan travel essentials (Suica, Pasmo, Google Translate)
- Mardi Himal trek (Nepal)
- Ultralight backpacking gear
- Budget vegan food in Japan
- Plant-based travel tips

## Hiking & Trail Guides

- [Guide to Hokkaido's best two-day hike: Asahidake to Kurodake traverse](https://letstalktrail.com/guide-to-hokkaidos-best-two-day-hike-asahidake-to-kurodake-traverse): Complete trail guide for Asahidake to Kurodake traverse in Hokkaido, Japan
- [Kyoto's best hiking trails](https://letstalktrail.com/kyotos-best-hiking-trails): Kyoto hiking guide featuring Fushimi Inari Shrine and Mount Inari trails
- [A 2023 how-to guide to trekking Mardi Himal](https://letstalktrail.com/a-2023-guide-to-trekking-mardi-himal): Mardi Himal trek guide covering permits and Annapurna region hiking
- [Tips for your first hut to hut hike](https://letstalktrail.com/basic-tips-for-your-first-hut-to-hut-hike): Beginner guide to hut-to-hut hiking with Leave No Trace principles

## Japan Travel Essentials

- [Preparing your trip to Japan - 7 essential tips](https://letstalktrail.com/preparing-your-trip-to-japan-7-essential-tips): Japan travel preparation guide covering visas, SIM cards, and essentials
- [Ten things you absolutely need for your trip to Japan](https://letstalktrail.com/ten-things-for-your-trip-to-japan): Japan travel essentials including Suica, Pasmo IC cards and Google Maps

## Vegan & Vegetarian Dining Guides

- [6 tips for being vegan in Japan](https://letstalktrail.com/6-tips-for-being-vegan-in-japan): Vegan travel tips for Japan covering shojin ryori and plant-based dining
- [2023 guide to Tokyo's best vegan & vegetarian restaurants](https://letstalktrail.com/2023-guide-to-tokyos-best-vegan-restaurants): Tokyo vegan and vegetarian restaurant guide including Vegan Gyoza Yu
- [4x cheap vegan food under 1000 yen in Japan](https://letstalktrail.com/4x-vegan-food-under-1000-yen-in-japan): Budget vegan dining guide for Japan under 1000 yen including Mos Burger
- [The three best vegan okonomiyaki restaurants in Hiroshima](https://letstalktrail.com/the-three-best-vegan-okonomiyaki-restaurants-in-hiroshima): Hiroshima vegan okonomiyaki restaurant guide featuring Nagataya
- [2024 Guide to the best Vegan and Vegetarian Restaurants in Utrecht](https://letstalktrail.com/2023-guide-to-vegan-vegetarian-restaurants-utrecht): Utrecht plant-based dining guide featuring Life's a Peach and Gys Utrecht
